objective: To add, view and edit the distance (KM) between two locations registered in Master Location.
To provide the mileage used by TC-PBR to calculate the variable cost of each delivery: Variable Cost = Mileage (KM) x Price per KM.
To prevent invalid routes: same From / To, mileage <= 0, duplicate From + To, or locations that are not active in Master Location.
To create or update many routes at once from an Excel template (same layout and function as the Planning Order upload): the file is validated when chosen and saved at once when every row is valid.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Title 'Route Mileage', breadcrumb 'Master - Route Mileage'.
Input Section in Add Mode: From = 'Select From Location', To = 'Select To Location', Mileage blank.
From / To list contains only ACTIVE locations of Master Location, shown as 'Code - Name', sorted by code. Location data is not hard-coded.
Route Mileage List shows all routes (10 rows per page) with the default columns. If none exist, message no. 11.
5.2 Location Selection
Click / focus From or To: open the list. Typing filters by code or name (partial, case-insensitive). Arrow keys + Enter select; Esc closes.
Only listed values can be selected (no free text). Leaving the field without selecting keeps the previous value.
A location added in Master Location is available in the list immediately; an INACTIVE location is not listed.
5.3 Save (Add / Edit)

items: Step 1 - Mandatory: From (no. 1), To (no. 2), Mileage (no. 3). Messages are shown under each field. Stop.
Step 2 - From must differ from To (no. 4). Stop.
Step 3 - Mileage numeric and > 0; 0, negative and non-numeric rejected; max 2 decimals (no. 5). Stop.
Step 4 (Add) - From and To must be ACTIVE in Master Location (no. 6); From + To must not exist yet, Active or Inactive (no. 7). Stop.
Step 5 - Save in one DB transaction with audit fields; Edit also checks the version (no. 8). Disable Save while processing.
Success: reset the form to Add Mode, refresh the list, show message no. 9 (Add) / 10 (Edit).

operation.text: Backend validation applies the same rules and messages as the screen.
5.4 Edit
Click a row: From, To, Mileage are loaded; From / To read only; row highlighted (Edit Mode).
Only Mileage can be changed. Created By / Created Date are never overwritten; Updated By / Change Date are set on save.
Cancel discards the change and returns to Add Mode.
5.5 Search, Table View, Export
Search filters immediately on all list columns; no match: message no. 12.
Table View shows / hides columns (Created By, Changed By hidden by default).
Export .xls exports all rows matching Search with the visible columns; Mileage exported as number.
5.6 Route Direction and Uniqueness
A route is directional: From -> To and To -> From are separate records and may have different mileage.
Unique key = Location From + Location To.
5.7 TC-PBR Variable Cost
TC-PBR looks up the ACTIVE mileage for the delivery From + To and the applicable Price per KM (Price Master, TBD).
Variable Cost = Mileage (KM) x Price per KM. Example: DPCMR -> CYSTR = 16 KM; SNT -> KRW = 65 KM x IDR 5,000 = IDR 325,000.
Route not found: never use 0 KM. Flag the delivery, show message no. 13 and do not calculate the variable cost until valid mileage exists.
5.8 Status (not shown on this screen)

Records are never physically deleted. The requirement defines Active / Inactive with deactivation confirmation; the existing screen has no status column or action, so STATUS is stored as Active (TBD, OP-02).
Inactive mileage stays for history and is not used for new TC-PBR calculations.
5.9 Security and Audit
Access follows the existing role framework (View / Add / Edit / Export Master Mileage, TBD).
Audit fields: Created By, Created Date, Updated By, Change Date.
5.10 Excel Upload, layout and function like Planning Order (MM-20 to MM-29, refer UISS-Batch 'Master Mileage - Route Mileage Upload')

Placement as in Planning Order: accordion 'Upload Excel' (Filename, Choose File, *) Download Template) open on top, accordion 'Manual Entry' (Input Section) below and collapsed; both headers show 'IELP Admin only'.
*) Download Template: Excel with sheet Route Mileage (header FROM CODE | TO CODE | MILEAGE (KM)), Active Locations and Notes (msg 23).

Choose File: 'Validating Excel file...' is shown; the file is checked (type, template columns, 1-1,000 rows; msg 16 / 17 / 18 / 19) and every row is validated with the screen rules (MM-01..MM-03, MM-06), duplicates in the file and inactive existing routes.
Any error: modal 'Upload validation failed' with Row / Column / Error (msg 20), Download error list (CSV) and Close and correct the file; nothing is saved. All routes with the same mileage: msg 21.

No error: saved immediately in one transaction (all-or-nothing): New route = insert Active, existing Active route with other mileage = update, same mileage = skipped. List refreshed, uploaded rows highlighted, msg 22 (+ 'n route(s) unchanged').
Database Specification (ELIPS AE070_ILS_DB)

Source of truth for tables / columns / types: docs/db/ELIPS_Schema.sql. No sample data was available: value lists and status codes are TBD. Status: Verified = UISS already matched the schema; Revised = changed to the schema in this revision; Conflict = code / UISS rule not supported by the table; TBD = not confirmed.
Conflicts (UISS / code vs ELIPS schema) - application not changed

items: G-MML-01 Mileage decimals: UISS / code: Number 7,2 (max 2 decimals). DB: MILEAGE decimal(18,0) - no decimals. Recommendation: Round to whole KM in the UI or change the column (DB change request)

G-MML-02 Route key: UISS / code: From + To unique. DB: PK = LOC_NAME_FROM + FROM_CODE; TO_CODE nullable, not in key. Recommendation: Only one route per From is possible with this PK - confirm the table or change the PK

G-MML-03 Location names stored: UISS / code: Names read from Master Location. DB: LOC_NAME_FROM / LOC_NAME_TO NOT NULL in TB_M_MILEAGE (denormalised). Recommendation: Copy names on insert / update; define refresh when a location is renamed
G-MML-04 Active / Inactive and VERSION: UISS / code: STATUS, VERSION. DB: Only IS_DELETE varchar(5); no VERSION. Recommendation: Map status to IS_DELETE; concurrency by CHANGED_DT
